summary: Our mission was to teach the advantage, disadvantages and consequances of action  during a mission on self sustaining facility. It is important as they'll have to balance everything from power and life support to supplies and crew needs across simulated lunar days. Systems engineering is a really tough subject to teach. Real missions are too expensive and rare for students to experience, and textbooks don't really show how one small decision can affect everything else. For example CO2 removel or Electrolyze water to produce oxygen which uses electricity.
details: We used S.I to make the main code fixed some of the bug by hand. It was designed as a fun game to attract the junior astronauts. It can help comperhending systems engineering to younger generation.
